title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: OpenDots: CopilotKit ships an MIT-licensed, self-hosted template for persistent AI coworkers across text, calls and Slack
bullets.summary: Specialist agents with scoped tool permissions, shared working spaces, isolated browser environments, Slack and voice channels, and background task scheduling; unrelated to OpenAI's Dots (Oct 1).
bullets.how: The Construct: a reference architecture for always-on agents with per-agent tool permissions, compare against the Hermes/routine setup. PRAGMA: a ready template for client persistent-coworker pilots.

bullets.title: DeepSeek Harness (dsh): open-source, MIT-licensed 'everything-is-a-plugin' agent harness with web, desktop and CLI front ends
bullets.summary: Developer preview from DeepSeek AI built on the Cordis plugin framework; desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux reported Oct 3.
bullets.how: The Construct: a model-agnostic harness to benchmark against Claude-based flows; expect breaking changes. PRAGMA: another client option when a non-US model is mandated.

bullets.title: Pi 1.0 from Earendil: minimal, extensible agent harness with native MCP support, plus experimental Pi Durable for longer-running tasks
bullets.summary: Adds native MCP, virtual model extensions, mid-conversation system message changes and better Claude caching; Pi Durable is a separate experimental substrate for long-running work (Oct 3).
bullets.how: The Construct: Pi Durable's separate-substrate approach to long jobs is worth reading for scheduled-run resilience. PRAGMA: lightweight harness option for small client builds.

bullets.title: Claude for Government reaches general availability with FedRAMP High authorization
bullets.summary: Anthropic's platform for federal and state agencies ships with governance controls, spend limits and audit logging (Sep 30).
bullets.how: Not relevant to signage or current Construct work; only a signal that audit logging and spend limits are becoming standard, which PRAGMA can cite in compliance-minded client pitches.

praxis_lesson: The same persistent-agent pattern is now shipping as open-source templates (OpenDots, Pi Durable, DeepSeek Harness), so the harness is commoditizing. Keep value in your own state files, permissions and evals, and treat any harness as swappable.
